items.reasons: A flat front view of a tall dark box with a white cluster of pins stuck onto its face, sitting on a wooden lane stub, with no top plane. At 1x it reads as an odd wooden cabinet, not a bowling pin setup.

The machines are drawn as a flat front view with only a thin 1–2 row grey top strip, so there is no real top plane. The red stools sit on a separate beige band that looks detached from the island instead of standing on the floor in front of it.
Very low-contrast black-on-dark-grey shading turns into a muddy dark column at 1x, and the woofer cone barely shows. The thin strip is also too narrow and small next to the originals.

Under each cabinet there is a brown block with a face-like pair of dots, with a red stool stacked straight below it. The cabinet, base and stool stack into one confusing column. The brown/orange cabinet sides look muddy next to the originals' clean dark outlines.
The saturated purple sits outside the chipset's muted palette. The candy pile on the counter top and the cubby contents are noisy rainbow 'sticker' clusters with no form shading.
Mostly a flat pink front view with only a thin light top band and no readable roof plane. The outline is pink/magenta rather than the originals' dark navy outline weight.
The screen is filled with random white/green speckle noise, and the grey seat/base area is a flat slab that blends into the floor. Too busy compared with the originals' clean shading.
The blue cabinet shows a clear top plane with the screen and a row of coloured buttons on the control deck. The outline and palette sit close to the originals, and it stands on the floor cleanly.

The pale beige outline and low-contrast shading don't match the originals' dark outlines. The plinth has a drawer and handle, so it reads as a nightstand with a jar on it rather than a display plinth.
The slanted lectern top is visible from above, with a crest on the front panel and two microphone goosenecks. The outline and wood shading match the chipset, and it sits on the floor.

The top plank is visible as a lit plane above a short front face, with varied book spines in four cubbies. The dark outline and wood palette match the wardrobe original, and it stands cleanly against the wall.
The wooden stage deck is visible from above as a wide lit plane, with a pink striped heart backdrop and a mic stand. The front skirt has a ground line, and the scale fits the room.
The counter top is a clear lit plane holding a popcorn machine, drink dispenser, cups and register, over a striped front face. It reads at 1x and sits on the floor.
The animals in the cages are brown/grey blobs with stray red pixels and can't be read. The blue bundle on top looks like a pasted-on sticker, and at 1x the whole thing reads as a grey fridge.
The shelf top plane is visible, with clear rows of medicine boxes and a drawer base. The green cross sign sits on top within the footprint, and the outline and wood palette match the originals.
The wooden top plank is lit from above, with gold/silver trophies behind the glass panes. Clean outline, it reads at 1x and stands on the floor.
The enclosed wooden box shows its desk top from above, with a black microphone and paneled front. The wood palette and outline match the wardrobe original, and the ground line is clear.
The pegboard items are muddy red/yellow clusters that can't be identified as bags, belts or scarves. The beige frame is low contrast against the floor, and at 1x it reads as noise.
A flat front view of a grey slab with no top plane at all. It is also very narrow and small next to the chipset's furniture.
A flat front-view white tower with no visible top surface. The glasses are dark 2–3px blobs that don't read as eyewear at 1x.
